tunnelSettings.title: Remote access
tunnelSettings.subtitle: Expose this gateway on the internet so the mobile app can connect from anywhere. Off by default for your security.
tunnelSettings.needToken: Sign in to the gateway (valid token) to manage remote access.
tunnelSettings.riskBannerBody: Remote access exposes your gateway on the public internet. Only enable when you understand the risks.
tunnelSettings.emptyStateBody: Start remote access to reach this gateway from your phone or anywhere on the internet.
tunnelSettings.consentExpiredBanner: The remote access security notice was updated. Re-confirm before starting the tunnel or enabling auto-start.
tunnelSettings.startProgressHint: First start can take 2–4 minutes (DNS propagation + HTTPS). DNS validation retries once automatically. The public URL appears before the tunnel is fully ready.
tunnelSettings.publicUrlPendingNotice: Public URL is assigned. Finish the remaining steps before using it remotely.
tunnelSettings.stepRegisterDetail: Public URL assigned — HTTPS and frp connection still in progress
tunnelSettings.stepTlsDetail: Requesting TLS certificate for your subdomain
tunnelSettings.stepTlsDnsPropagation: Waiting for DNS on all public resolvers (can take 2–4 minutes)
tunnelSettings.stepFrpcDetail: Waiting for frpc login (up to 60 seconds)
tunnelSettings.releaseHint: Revokes the subdomain on the broker. Your next start will get a new public URL.
tunnelSettings.releaseConfirmBody: This deregisters the tunnel on frp.xopc.ai and clears saved credentials. You will get a new subdomain when you start remote access again.
tunnelSettings.autoStartHint: Available after you start remote access once and accept the security notice.
tunnelSettings.autoStartConfirmTitle: Start tunnel on every gateway launch?
tunnelSettings.autoStartConfirmBody: Your gateway will be reachable from the internet whenever it runs. Only enable if you accept that risk.
tunnelSettings.consentIntro: Read carefully before exposing your gateway:
tunnelSettings.consentBullet1: A public URL lets anyone who obtains it use your gateway Bearer token.
tunnelSettings.consentBullet2: Traffic is proxied via frp.xopc.ai (third-party infrastructure).
tunnelSettings.consentBullet3: Use a strong token; stop the tunnel when you do not need remote access.
tunnelSettings.consentCheckbox: I understand these risks and want to enable remote access
tunnelSettings.brokerNote: Traffic is proxied via frp.xopc.ai. Keep your gateway token private.
tunnelSettings.brokerSecretHint: Authorize with your XOPC account to create and save a registration key automatically. You can still create and paste a key manually.
tunnelSettings.brokerSecretMaskedHelp: A key is saved in local config. You can view, copy, or replace it.
tunnelSettings.brokerSecretPlaceholderKeep: Paste a new Tunnel Registration Key
tunnelSettings.brokerSecretMissingHint: OAuth uses only the tunnel:register permission. The resulting key is saved locally in xopc.json.
tunnelSettings.brokerSecretRequiredBeforeStart: Save a Tunnel Registration Key above before starting remote access.
tunnelSettings.brokerSecretReadyHint: You can start remote access below. Use Reconfigure to replace the key.
tunnelSettings.brokerSecretRevealFailed: Could not load the saved key
tunnelSettings.brokerSecretNotInConfigFile: Key is not in the config file; plaintext cannot be shown.
